criterion: Promote the fixed SMA(20/50) specification to the one-time test only if it does not materially underperform buy-and-hold in the validation period. This criterion is fixed before any test access and no parameter is tuned.
rationale: This fixed SMA specification materially underperformed buy-and-hold in the validation period, so it is not promoted to the one-time test. This is a statement about one fixed specification on one validation period only — not a claim that moving-average strategies fail in general, and not a claim that buy-and-hold is itself an alpha strategy (it is the benchmark).
subject: sma_20_50
